name: codequest
description: CodeQuest — a level-based coding contest platform (monorepo: Express API + React SPA).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace codequest-server && npm run build --workspace codequest-client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace codequest-server && npm run lint --workspace codequest-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace codequest-server && npm run typecheck --workspace codequest-client
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
